name: Hinata Ichika
source:
An ordinary girl who enjoys drawing. She has a complicated family situation, so she's always in need of housing and money. She built relationships with various men on dating sites, constantly having to take risks until one day where she discovered the works of “Saison”, which helped her remember her dreams.

[Translated from the [url=https://enoshima210.work/2023/05/24/sini/]official website[/url]]
